mapper.insert: insert into tb_board (user_email, board_title, board_content,board_likes,board_views) values (#{userEmail}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent},#{boardLikes},#{boardViews})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_idx AS boardIdx, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, b.user_email AS userEmail, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, b.board_write_dt AS boardWriteDt, b.board_views AS boardViews, b.board_likes AS boardLikes, b.board_del_yn AS boardDelYn, COALESCE(COUNT(c.comment_idx), 0) AS commentCount FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.user_email = u.user_email LEFT JOIN tb_comment c ON b.board_idx = c.board_idx GROUP BY b.board_idx ORDER BY b.board_write_dt DESC;

SELECT b.board_idx AS boardIdx, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, b.user_email AS userEmail, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, b.board_write_dt AS boardWriteDt, b.board_views AS boardViews, b.board_likes AS boardLikes, b.board_del_yn AS boardDelYn, COALESCE(COUNT(c.comment_idx), 0) AS commentCount FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.user_email = u.user_email LEFT JOIN tb_comment c ON b.board_idx = c.board_idx WHERE b.board_title Like #{searchValue} GROUP BY b.board_idx ORDER BY b.board_write_dt DESC;
